summary: 5-day hands-on training in hospital operations and healthcare facility management. Master CMMS, NFPA compliance, FCI assessment, and HICS. Enrol today.
lede: Healthcare facility operations training helps facility managers and operations leaders maintain reliable infrastructure while coordinating safety, compliance, and patient flow. It develops skills in assessing assets and scheduling preventive maintenance, documenting life-safety compliance and planning capital work, and improving patient flow and emergency preparedness using operational data and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who carry direct responsibility for hospital operations, healthcare infrastructure, or clinical environment management — whether you oversee a single facility or a multi-site health system. It is equally relevant to those stepping into a senior facility management role and those looking to formalise and deepen operational knowledge they have built through years of hands-on experience.
modules: Hospital Facility Management: Roles, Scope, and Governance
Facility Condition Assessment and Asset Management
Preventive and Predictive Maintenance in Healthcare Facilities
Regulatory Compliance and Life Safety Management
Patient Flow Optimisation and Space Utilisation
Capital Planning, Finance, and Facility Budget Management
Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity in Healthcare
Facility KPI Dashboards, Reporting, and Strategic Planning
prerequisites: To participate effectively in this course, you should meet the following requirements: Experience: A minimum of 2–3 years working in a healthcare facility, hospital operations, clinical engineering, or building maintenance environment; Familiarity with building systems: Basic working knowledge of HVAC, electrical distribution, plumbing, or medical gas systems in a healthcare context; Compliance exposure: Some prior exposure to a healthcare accreditation or regulatory compliance process (e.g., Joint Commission survey preparation, CMS inspection, or equivalent); No coding or programming required: All digital exercises use scenario templates and pre-configured dashboards — no software development skills are needed; Laptop recommended: Participants are encouraged to bring a laptop for CMMS simulation exercises and KPI dashboard workshops; datasets and templates will be provided
